resources.string: Require phone authentication to view or change the recovery key used by encrypted backups.

Require your current PIN to change or disable it in this app, and to turn this setting on or off. Remember your PIN: Forgot PIN cannot bypass this check. Disabling the PIN also turns off this setting. This protects only this app; copied recovery credentials can still be used directly with the service.
Try experimental features from Signal. These features may change as they are developed.
Show archive controls in Stories settings. Turn on “Keep stories in archive” there to save your own stories. Hiding these controls does not change your archive settings.
Filter search results by date and sender using the filter button in the search toolbar.
Star messages from the long-press menu to find them later in conversation settings or the main menu.
